detail.title: Investigating Structural Sources of Observer Disagreement
detail.summary: We are continuing research into the structural and predictive foundations of observer disagreement. The current notebook is in early stages, lacking sufficient evidence to support a robust synthesis. We are initiating targeted research to identify how epistemic and institutional frameworks influence the interpretative variance between independent, rigorous observers, as outlined in the active project proj-observer-disagreement-001.
